page.title: Needs you
page.purpose: One feed of everything supervisors are waiting on, answered with the offered options or in the operator's own words, with delivery status and the reason an item was not sent.

states.description: Collapsed rows (title, where it came from, delivery state, recommended answer) that open on tap; a link to commission plus ID scrolls to the item and opens it; answered items show the answer and whether the supervisor has read it; an item whose ID was already answered or delivered reads 'ID reused, not delivered' and offers no answer; a global item without a commission says what to do and links where it is answered; an older-format list is a row in the same feed, readable on tap, never sent or answerable, and counted with the items; files that cannot be read are listed, never shown as an empty feed; the courier's real state and its confirmed self-test; with items open and nothing delivered, one warning line.
Nothing is waiting for the operator.
The desk is not authorized: a banner says answers cannot be recorded until it is, and answer buttons are disabled.
The confirm dialog shows the exact entry from the API's dry run, where it is appended and when it is read, and stays open on failure with the API's reason.
The API cannot be reached or refused the read; the page names which and offers retry, and nothing else on the page pretends to know.
The page announces that it is reading the research home; nothing is shown as known until it is.
An optional scenario is down: only the values it feeds read unknown, each with the reason; everything read from files is still shown.
A refresh failed after a good read: the earlier read stays on screen under a 'Not current' notice with its time and the reason.
